provenance: All values come from WebSearch results (40 searches, the full budget); no page or PDF was opened, so page is null throughout. quote is the text exactly as the result gave it: quote_kind 'extract' where the result presented it as the page's words, 'summary' where it is the search tool's wording. url_certain=false where the result did not tie the statement to one page; url is then the likeliest page and alt_urls the other candidates. Currency is as written in the quote ('$' where the quote names none), with currency_note giving context. Nothing was converted, derived or taken from memory. Fields already present in gold_studies.json or copper_studies.json were not repeated.
